The world of scan-read-again-alone-when-two-environments-use-one-database, and then prod is bound to another database of the same name. The read of prod is given alone: the other database is a new node, and the binding that the extraction declared by name still points to the first one, because the extraction was not read again. Then the extraction is read again with the same content. The first database is no longer stated in prod, so the name in prod no longer fits it; it fits the other database alone and goes there (N3). A description stays with its node only while the node still fits it.
